items.finding: Rename original builder to static width-aware helper
Add explicit width/native-policy arguments and excluded alternative
Skip original Limit increment for native-policy callers
Choose frame size from explicit width

initial_review: Original BuildStackFrame reads CurrentAppFlags and increments raw Limit before granularity expansion. Current wrapper1278-1280 passes Frame32,FALSE; dpmiint.h:49 defines Frame32 as BOOL CurrentAppFlags. Software interrupt615 passes handler width,TRUE. Original other callers723/812/899/1014 retain wrapper. Native NT PushInt uses handler width and different limit comparisons; deleting one policy fragment alone is not original restoration.
counter_review: A shared function body already exists; removing wrapper or adding a second implementation is not automatically simplification. Ordinary width is preserved by the Frame32 alias, while native policy intentionally changes limits and width source. No runtime necessity or complete equivalence asserted.
verification: Original/current source, call sites and macro definition inspected; no new tests or product edits.
